title: Average monthly income per agricultural household

source.title: Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households (70th and 77th rounds); 2015-16 is the DFI Committee estimate

note: 2015-16 is a committee estimate (Rs 96,703/yr) derived from 2012-13 data, per Scroll and Down To Earth, not a survey result. Rounds are not strictly comparable. Nominal values; target line is 2x of the 2015-16 baseline.
